{/* Hero Section */}

Our Programs & Initiatives

Like children of parents, these programs are offspring that further develop the vision of Nile Orphan Care. Each child in our care receives these expressions of love.

{/* Programs Section */}

Core Programs

Comprehensive support systems designed to nurture every aspect of a child's development

{/* Nutrition Program */}

Love the Hungry (LTH)

Nutrition Program

Since 2013, Love the Hungry has provided fortified meals to children under Nile Orphan Care to improve wellbeing, health, and growth.

Key Impacts:

  • Nutritious meal provision — delivering fortified, age-appropriate meals
  • Program scalability and partnerships — expanding feeding reach
  • Sustainability and capacity building — developing local distribution systems
{/* Medical Care */}

Partners for Compassionate Care (PCC)

Medical Care & Health Education

PCC has helped establish and operate an on-site clinic at NOC with a full-time nurse providing 24/7 coverage, five days a week.

Key Impacts:

  • Access to primary healthcare — on-site medical services
  • Integrated healthcare and education — merging care with training
  • Sustainable, locally-rooted programs — building ongoing local impact
{/* Discipleship */}

Discipleship Global (DG)

Discipleship & Biblical Training

Training children to be disciples using the Paul and Timothy biblical method to develop deeper relationships with Jesus Christ.

Key Impacts:

  • Disciple multiplication — training followers to make new disciples
  • Leadership development — equipping local leaders with biblical skills
  • Church planting and sustainability — supporting indigenous ministries
{/* Education */}

Inter-Ethnic Academy

Primary & Secondary Education

Free, quality education addressing South Sudan's tribal divisions. 63 of the 64 tribes are represented in our student body, promoting unity through education.

Key Features:

  • Inter-tribal unity through shared learning
  • Quality education for all children in our care
  • Peace education integrated into curriculum
{/* Vocational Training */}

Technical & Vocational Training

Skills Development

Providing extra skills to children who have finished or are completing secondary school, helping them find or create job opportunities.

Benefits:

  • Practical skills for employment
  • Entrepreneurship opportunities
  • Economic empowerment
{/* Agriculture */}

Daalbaai Agriculture

Sustainable Farming

"Happiness is a result of availability of food" - promoting indigenous food production and reducing dependency on international aid.

Mission:

  • Indigenous food production
  • Reduced aid dependency
  • Utilizing South Sudan's fertile land
{/* Initiatives Section */}

Key Initiatives

Strategic programs addressing critical needs in our community

Clean Water & WASH

Solar water system providing safe, clean water for drinking and agriculture. Equipment for water treatment and general cleaning purposes.

Deep Water Well - Complete!

Food Security

620 kids fed daily through Love the Hungry partnership and Daalbaai agriculture program promoting food independence.

620 children fed daily

Safe Shelter

Providing secure housing, learning spaces, and sleeping quarters. Rebuilding after storm damage with stronger, concrete structures.

Continuous rebuilding efforts

Peace Education (SLOSS)

"Shed Light on South Sudan" - peace education curriculum for upper classes promoting unity and reconciliation among tribes.

63 of 64 tribes represented

Mission Outreach

"Children of the Beautiful Savior" - children share God's love in the community while maintaining non-discrimination policies.

Community impact

Health Education

Training on HIV/AIDS awareness, dental care, disease prevention, and general health education for children and families.

Comprehensive health training
